title: Statistical Process Control Charts for Drift in Concept Vectors Across Model Updates

original_idea.body: Apply SPC control charts (CUSUM/Shewhart) to monitor concept-vector drift across public fine-tuned checkpoints. Inference-only, no training.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Plausible chain: SPC early-warning for vector drift aids monitoring continuity, but the link is one step broader (level 3).

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Re-extract vectors across public checkpoints + control charts; clear methodology, novice+mentor feasible (level 4).

narrow_scope.reasoning: Focused deliverable (control charts + recipe), assembling multiple checkpoints adds modest effort (level 4).

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Independent-friendly monitoring-infrastructure work on public checkpoints (level 4).

low_compute.reasoning: Inference-only extraction on existing checkpoints, single GPU (level 4).

novelty.reasoning: Vector-drift is a stated open problem; SPC framing may add modest novelty.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Drift monitoring is the open problem; the SPC recipe framing may add novelty.
